title: Given a binary tree and an array of numbers representing a sequence, determine whether there exists a root-to-leaf path such that the node values along the path exactly match the sequence in order and length. Explain how an index into the sequence tracks progress during the depth-first search.
shortTitle: Path With Given Sequence (Does a Root-to-Leaf Path Match an Exact Sequence?)
keyPoints: Carry an index into the target sequence and advance it at each matching node during DFS
Reject immediately if the node is null, the index exceeds the sequence length, or the value mismatches
Succeed only at a leaf where the index has consumed exactly the last element of the sequence
A path that matches the sequence as a prefix but continues past it is not a valid match
A path that ends before consuming the full sequence is also rejected by the leaf-index check
Time is O(n) visiting each node once; space is O(h) for the recursion stack

s1_definition.oneliner: Match node values against the sequence by index as you descend, and succeed only when a leaf lands exactly at the end of the sequence.
s1_definition.profdef:
- **Path With Given Sequence** checks if any root-to-leaf path matches a fixed target sequence in both order and length.
- **Index tracking** carries a position pointer into the sequence, advancing it at each node whose value matches.
- **Three-way guard** rejects immediately on null node, index out of range, or value mismatch.
- **Exact-length rule** requires the match to consume the full sequence at a leaf, rejecting both prefix-only and incomplete paths.
- **Time** is O(n) because each node is visited at most once; **space** is O(h) for the call stack.
s1_definition.analogy: At the National Bank of India, a high-value payment must travel through an exact pre-approved sequence of desk codes, like a mandated compliance handshake. Rajesh is given the required sequence and the desk hierarchy. He walks down comparing each desk code to the next expected code, and if he ever finds a mismatch he abandons that chain. A match is valid only when a complete chain from top to bottom consumes the entire mandated sequence with no codes left over and no missing steps.

sections.s3_flow:
```text
  Index-tracking DFS for sequence [1, 9, 1]
  ==========================================

  Tree:       1 (index=0, seq[0]=1 match)
             / \
            7    9
  (idx=1)  /      \ (idx=1, seq[1]=9 match)
     7!=9 ✗        9
                  / \
         (idx=2) 2    1 (idx=2, seq[2]=1 match)
           2!=1 ✗     leaf + index at end → TRUE

  Decision flow at each node:
  ┌──────────────────────────┐
  │ node == null?  → false   │
  │ index >= len?  → false   │
  │ val != seq[i]? → false   │
  │ leaf && i==end → true    │
  │ else → recurse(i+1)     │
  └──────────────────────────┘
```
sections.s6_takeaway:
Path With Given Sequence asks whether any root-to-leaf path in a binary tree matches a fixed target sequence exactly, both in order and in length. The solution is a depth-first traversal that carries an index into the sequence. At each node you reject immediately if the node is null, if the index has overrun the sequence, or if the node value differs from the expected sequence element. You declare success only at a leaf where the index sits on the last element of the sequence.

The subtlety is that the match must be exact in length. A path that matches the sequence as a prefix but then continues to extra nodes is not a match, because the internal node fails the leaf check. A path that ends before consuming the full sequence is not a match either, because the leaf fails the index-at-end check. These two guards together enforce the exact-length requirement without any extra logic.

The algorithm is O(n) time and O(h) space, and the short-circuit OR means the first matching path stops the search immediately. In production at the National Bank of India, Rajesh used this to validate that high-value payments traveled through an exact regulator-approved sequence of desk codes, where any deviation was a compliance failure flagged by the system.

Remember one sentence: carry an index into the sequence, reject on any mismatch, and accept only at a leaf that has consumed the entire sequence.
